newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts variable mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts variable mortgage rates.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday it would cut its variable home loan interest rate to 8.75 percent from 9.25 percent from November 11 for new loans and from December 16 for existing loans.

ANZ said it had decided to cut the variable rate after the Reserve Bank of Australia's announcement earlier on Wednesday that it would cut official cash interest rates to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
"By acting quickly to pass on the RBA rate cut, we are ensuring that our customers continue to receive the best deals in the market," ANZ Retail General Manger Peter Hawkins said.
The cut applies to variable rate investment and owner-occupier loans.
